nextPageToken.description: Use this token to request the next page of results.

projects.description: Projects to which the user has at least READ access. This field can be omitted if `totalItems` is 0.

friendlyName.description: A descriptive name for this project. A wrapper is used here because friendlyName can be set to the empty string.

id.description: An opaque ID of this project.

numericId.description: The numeric ID of this project.

kind.description: The resource type of the response.

totalItems.description: The total number of projects in the page. A wrapper is used here because the field should still be in the response when the value is 0.

etag.description: A hash of the page of results.
